name: AI Chat Interface
summary: A single centred column, one large input at the bottom, streaming text, suggestion chips and almost no chrome. It came with ChatGPT in 2022 and makes language the main control.

philosophy.core_thesis: The interface is a conversation: one box to speak into, and everything else appears in the reply.
design_principles: Centre one column of 680px to 768px; use a measure of 60 to 75 characters and 16px to 17px text with a leading of 1.6.
Dock a single input at the bottom: height 56px to 120px that grows to 200px, radius 16px to 28px, with a send button of 32px to 40px inside it.
Mark user turns with a tinted bubble (radius 18px, max width 80%) and leave assistant turns as plain text with no bubble.
Stream text word by word at 20 to 60 words per second and show a 12px pulsing cursor or dot while it streams.
Offer 3 to 4 suggestion chips (height 36px to 44px, radius 999px) on the empty state and 2 to 3 follow-ups after a reply.
Hide the sidebar by default on screens under 768px and keep it 260px wide on desktop with one row per chat of 36px.
Show sources, tools and code as collapsible blocks with a 1px border and 12px radius; code blocks use a mono face at 13px.
anti_patterns: Dashboards of tiles and many menus beside the chat
Heavy bubbles around every assistant message
Multi-column layouts for the main reply
Typing indicators that fake a human
Hidden input that needs a click to open

layout.grid_mechanics: One centred column of 680px to 768px, a docked input and an optional sidebar of 260px; a 4px baseline.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 50% to 70% of the surface stays empty on desktop; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred column; text flush left; user messages flush right; input centred under the column.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded input of 16px to 28px radius; user bubbles 18px; blocks 12px; chips 999px.

font_pairings.note: A neutral UI face for chat and a code face for blocks.
A literary serif for reply text with a sans for the interface.
A single family with a matched mono.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and medium (500) or semibold (600) for headings in replies.
Set the greeting on the empty state at 28px to 36px.
Set code at 13px in a mono face.

color.palette_structure: A quiet neutral ground, one accent and soft tints for user turns.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on page holds 16:1; muted holds at least 4.5:1; the accent marks the cursor, links and the send button.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque neutral surfaces; no gradient; one tint step for the user bubble.
color.light_and_shadow: None; a 1px border and a 0 1px 2px shadow at 6% on the input only.

materiality.surface_simulation: Plain digital paper: neutral surfaces with no material.
materiality.border_rules: 1px border in #E4E4E7 on the input, blocks and chips.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. A single soft shadow of 0 1px 2px at 6% on the input; no elevation elsewhere.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1.5px outline icons with round caps at 16px to 20px; the send button is a filled circle.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None in the reply flow; one small brand mark on the empty state.

motion.transition_physics: Streaming: text appears word by word at 20 to 60 words per second; a new message slides up 8px in 200ms; the input grows in 120ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shows the message actions (copy, retry) at 100% opacity; active state on the send button darkens it by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that they are talking with a patient, capable partner.

avoid_when: The task needs a spatial or multi-panel view.
The content is browsing of many items.
The user needs a form with many fields.

modifiers.how: Set replies in a serif at 18px and add a paper-tone background and hairline rules.
Switch to a dark ground, add a mono face and show tool calls inline.
Add a soft gradient ground on the empty state only.

pack.why: A thin, neutral 1.5px line at 16px to 20px that stays quiet next to running text.
